Crisil was set up in 1987, promoted by ICICI and UTI with share capital from institutions including SBI, LIC and United India Insurance, at a moment when India's debt markets were small, bank- dominated and largely unrated. Its original name, Credit Rating Information Services of India Limited, described the job plainly: give lenders and investors an independent opinion on whether a borrower would repay.
